viewport_notes: search results with NO matches. The trap: a dead-end 'no results' with no way forward. It must HELP.

checks.rule: no Liquid/render errors, no broken layout — the empty state renders cleanly
the no-results state offers a path forward — a clear message + search box + suggestions / popular products / browse-collections link — NOT a blank dead end
the search input is present + prefilled with the query so the shopper can refine without retyping
no overflow/overlap; spacing intentional (no desolate void)
